_about: The builds: the same verified record read for nine kinds of role, plus six lot problems for dealers. One fact base for the build step on the title screen, the build screen and card, the tailored resumes (tools/verify/resume.mjs renders one PDF per build into assets/resume) and the listing match. Every proof is a fact already in llms.txt, written in Jason's first person; every headline and summary is in llms.txt under 'Nine Ways To Read The Record'. A proof marked skill: true is a skill, not a duty: the resumes print it in Skills (a skills group in record.json names it), never as a bullet. No em dashes, no percent signs, never a computed rate. A proof's medal is a trophy slug or a proof medal in assets/game/medals.

builds.label: AI and Automation
builds.headline: Voice AI and Claude API workflows running in a live business.
builds.summary: I put AI to work where a business loses time. For a Houston used vehicle dealership I deployed inbound voice AI that books appointments into the CRM and live-transfers unresolved calls to staff, writing its prompts and call flows myself, and I built a Python, Claude API and n8n workflow that researches Facebook Marketplace leads, writes findings to the CRM and generates SOP-based reply text for follow-up. Rather than buying software, I build it for the bottleneck in front of me.

builds.label: Software and CRM
builds.headline: A TypeScript, Next.js and Supabase CRM in daily production use.
builds.summary: I build software people use every day. I designed and shipped a custom dealership CRM in TypeScript, React, Next.js, PostgreSQL and Supabase that three staff use daily across inventory, deals and follow-up. I designed its lead-to-title data model, roles and validation, tested its row-level security (RLS) policies to prevent unauthorized role access, and executed production schema migrations that preserved existing records.

builds.label: IT and Systems Support
builds.headline: Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, accounts, hardware, network and the CRM.
builds.summary: I keep a business's people and systems working. At a Houston used vehicle dealership I support the staff on the CRM, phones and computers, manage user accounts and permissions, and set up the hardware and network. I administer Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, and I built the CRM the staff work in, with row-level security (RLS) policies tested to prevent unauthorized role access and production schema migrations that preserved existing records.

builds.label: Operations and Logistics
builds.headline: Pricing, inventory, vendors, logistics, financing and title.
builds.summary: I keep a business moving from the first call to the finished paperwork. Since August 2024 I've managed operations for a Houston used vehicle dealership across pricing, inventory, vendors, logistics, financing and title processing, and I hire, schedule and manage its staff and write the SOPs they follow. Since June 2025 I've personally closed 53 vehicle sales and collected $206,777 in sale proceeds, and I built the CRM the team works in every day.

builds.label: Title and Back Office
builds.headline: Texas title transfers inside the 30-day window, desk to file.
builds.summary: I get the paperwork right and on file. At a Houston used vehicle dealership I prepare and file title and registration paperwork, including the Form 130-U and webDEALER, and file title transfers inside the Texas 30-day window; handle lien payoffs, license plates and temporary tags; prepare deal jackets and contracts (bills of sale, buy here pay here contracts and disclosures); keep the dealer license compliance and record-keeping in order; and service buy here pay here accounts and collections. I speak Spanish professionally and proficiently, and I built the sale desk that routes each deal to the right documents with nothing missing and nothing extra.
